messages:
alex: Quick sync — following the postmortem, we need a short list of follow-ups for the GPU buffering pattern observed last week. I want owners + rough ETA by EOD so we can include in the remediation tracker.

maria: TL;DR of what we saw: small bursts cause scheduler to under-allocate buffer pools -> queue spikes -> temporary head-of-line latency. Recurring on m/tf workloads.

alex: Yep. Can you draft action items? I'll map to owners.

maria: Action 1: Scheduler conservative backoff option — add a tunable 'min_buffer' param and test on perf cluster. Owner: @maria. ETA: 2026-03-30 (P0). Acceptance: no buffer underflow in 99th pct on synthetic surges.

maria: Action 2: Quota page refresh — add short-term per-tenant soft limits to avoid one job starving others. Owner: @sophie. ETA: 2026-04-06 (P1). Acceptance: no single tenant >40% GPU reservation during burst windows.

alex: Action 3: Headroom dashboard and alert rule (ops + paging). Owner: @alex. ETA: 2026-03-27. Acceptance: alert fires <5s after sustained queue growth.

eng-ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: scheduler-config-v2 -> canary on perf-cluster at 2026-03-24T16:00Z (CI#4567).

tj: I'll pick up the scheduler experiment and build the harness for toks-per-sec patterns. Owner: @tj. ETA: 2026-03-28. Will log runs to /opt/perf/runs and share a short notebook.

sophie: For quotas: quick mitigation is to add a soft cap in routing layer that defers low-priority queues. I can prototype a 2-week toggle flag. ETA: 2026-03-31.

alex: Good. For the runbook, we should add a 'burst triage' section: how to check buffer occupancy, which metrics to escalate, and rollback steps. Who wants to own runbook update?

tj: I'll update runbook. ETA: 2026-03-26. Will include the CLI checks and a snippet for immediate triage.

alex: Example CLI snippet for quick triage (put in runbook):
```
# check scheduler buffer usage for clusterA
redwoodctl sched metrics --cluster clusterA --metric buffer_occupancy --window 60s
```

sophie: Can we add a visualization in Console for buffer_occupancy and per-tenant reservation? Ops + SRE will use it daily.

alex: Yes — I'll create a dashboard tile and share with ops. ETA: 2026-03-25.

maria: Also propose a recurring 30-min weekly sync for the next 6 weeks to watch regressions post-deploy. Owner: @maria. Start: 2026-03-29 recurring weekly.

tj: Notes on scheduler tuning experiments: will try two knobs: min_buffer and eviction_threshold. Quick test plan: 1) ramp synthetic burst to 3x baseline, 2) measure queue latency and GPU utilization, 3) compare with control.

alex: Add a short acceptance rubric in the tracker: latency reduction at 99th < 30% of baseline OR GPU utilization variance < 10% while keeping throughput.

sophie: For quota enforcement, need to check billing impacts. I'll coordinate with finance for potential customer-facing limits. Tagging @maria for prioritization.

maria: Noted. Finance sync scheduled 2026-03-29.

eng-ops-bot: incident-bot: New task created: TASK-7842 "Scheduler min_buffer rollout" assigned to tj, due 2026-03-28.

alex: Cool. Let's confirm owners in the remediation tracker by EOD. I'll update the sheet after this thread.

sophie: One small ask: can we make the canary include a traffic-shadowing mode before full traffic? Reduces blast radius.

tj: Happy to add shadowing to the canary. I'll coordinate with deploy team and add the flag to the canary script.

maria: I'll post a short regression prompt set for quality monitoring once the canary is up.

alex: Perfect. Last: please add a single-line status update each day until all items moved to 'in-progress' in the tracker.

sophie: ack :thumbsup:

tj: ack :rocket:

maria: ack :spiral_calendar:

alex: Thanks team — filing this thread into incidents tracker now.
